prompt: A vertical, full-body portrait of a young Japanese woman with a short, dark bob haircut and bangs, standing at the edge of an outdoor swimming pool. She is wearing a vintage-style, solid navy blue one-piece swimsuit. Her pose is dynamic; she leans slightly forward, pointing her right index finger directly at the camera lens with a confident, engaging expression, while her left arm hangs relaxed by her side. The background features a blurred public swimming pool scene with other swimmers in the water and a concrete building structure behind them. The image has a distinct retro aesthetic, mimicking a scanned photograph from a 1970s or 1980s Japanese photo magazine. This includes visible film grain, faded colors, and a paper texture overlay. Vertical Japanese text runs down the left and right margins, resembling magazine captions.

promptZh: 这是一张垂直构图的全身照，展示了一位站在户外游泳池旁的年轻日本女性。她留着黑色短发波波头，身穿深藏青色连体泳衣。她用右手指向镜头，左臂自然垂于身侧。她的表情平静且略带严肃。背景是一个公共游泳池，水中有其他游泳者，后方有建筑结构。图像呈现出昭和时代（20 世纪 70/80 年代）摄影特有的复古颗粒质感。图片左右两侧均有竖排日文文字，模仿杂志排版或写真集页面风格。光线为明亮的日光。
